features.branch_point: Number of carbon atoms with graph degree at least 3, including ring atoms; bond order does not affect degree.
features.carbon_atom: Number of atoms with atomic number 6.
features.chain_termini: Number of carbon atoms with graph degree exactly 1, including ring-attached terminal carbons.
features.halogen_atom: Number of F, Cl, Br, or I atoms (not other group-17 elements).
features.heavy_atom: Number of atoms with atomic number greater than 1.
features.hetero_atom: Number of atoms whose atomic number is neither 1 nor 6.
